fg@unknown: When we got to the end of the year we would give the children a present for them to take to their Apu and Ati, a small present they could give to them at Eratap.
fg@unknown: The year 1956, we gave them the small present again for them to give to them.
fg@unknown: Apu from Elaknar and Apu from Elaau they went to give it, then came back.
fg@unknown: After
fg@unknown: Pastor Kalagis wanted us to go to Eratap.
fg@unknown: We went to Elaknar and Tata Sailas was at his house. When he saw us
fg@unknown: and he said, "Webe, small fish they come and eat all the good food.
fg@unknown: The whales eat stones then they return."
fg@unknown: I already knew that he would tell us the meaning of this story that Sailas told us. And then he told us.
fg@unknown: He said one day small fish came would come out to eat
fg@unknown: but the whale was hitting the water (with its tail).
fg@unknown: But the small fish said now the tide is high
fg@unknown: some would go and say he should come." "We will all come and eat at the turn of the tide.
fg@unknown: When the tide was out and he returned
fg@unknown: and the whale said, "Okay, you eat on the incoming tide.
fg@unknown: I will come later." The small fish lay down and ate and the tide went out and they went back.
fg@unknown: The whale stayed at sea thrashing its tail
fg@unknown: and spurted water until it became hungry. And he thought he would go and eat.
fg@unknown: When he came and the tide had gone out, he got stuck and went back.
fg@unknown: Okay, when you look around our Efate, you will see whale shit rings the points around Efate.
fg@unknown: And we call it whale shit. A story from the old people.
fg@unknown: One day the hawks were telling stories.
fg@unknown: And the owl said to the hawk, "You go and get the herbs." And they promised to meet back again. "That is the time you will come."
fg@unknown: I will give you herbs, you drink it." They stayed until the time to meet back again, and the hawk brought the herbs.
fg@unknown: The owl came, then he told the hawk and mlapuas, "You will get the herbs for him and give it to him to drink it."
fg@unknown: Then mlapuas drank the owl's herbs, and he poured water for the owl.
fg@unknown: He went and drank the herbs that they got for the owl. He drank it all, but he poured water for the owl and took it to give him to drink.
fg@unknown: When he drank it all they met together again, and they said, "Now is the time for us to meet again and we will try to fly."
fg@unknown: Until it was the time of the meeting and they met. "Now we will fly."
fg@unknown: Then they flew, the owl flew below. He only flew below, but the hawk and mlapuas, mlapuas beat the hawk up high. It is just a short story.
fg@unknown: The owl can't fly high because it did not drink the herbs but mlapuas drank the owl's herbs.

fg@unknown: mlapuas beats the hawk up high. It is just a short story.

fg@unknown: they wanted to make laplap, they wanted to make laplap.

Tier-0: [continued from 98017b] {SPEAKER=Kaltap̃au} Ikat ktof, nana, sori, i on? Ikat ktof, nana,
Tier-0: pol, na, p̃ura ga. Ikatktof pura ga. [..] komkom ki ntuam i tarp̃ek ka i mat pe
Tier-0: Me ini komkom ki na p̃ura ga pa, i olwe me i pan los nrokot. I pan pan pan... pak elag Krikai,
Tier-0: pan lek (cough) kano ses ne plak mama ga, me i pak natkin teflan me i lai,
Tier-0: Ilai na p̃ura ni na ntuam ne. Me i na, Ga ki, Kai pe katpni.
Tier-0: Malfane tu po ler. Kineu a ru ler ga ru pak Egun pan kin go i [mu-imu-] ko imer ktom ki natam̃ol
Tier-0: kin pan pan pan kin mes nen kin natam̃ol ru po lap naur Egun. Tenen ga ipi natrausuen tilm̃ori. A nig tesa nen ru to trausi.
Tier-0: Kaaru nen a na ka trausi a na ka traus na, nafteme nana, natrausuen, ni, e, natrausuen gakit teni Efat,
Tier-0: teni nanre ni, na, {coughs} naftemena, ntan.
Tier-0: Ku leka kin mes kin komam u to pes ntan, m? Uto pes ntan a? U pes ntan me natam̃ol ru kenski ((against)) wou i top.
Tier-0: Ru putkau, ru putkau ki wou i top. Ru farfar top naga, kineu a pi natam̃ol psir.
Tier-0: Me itik. Kineu atil tenen i leg, a traus natrauswen leg. Reki natkon seserik nigtuei ru si slat silua nrak pei
Tier-0: gar itli pan pan..... mes kin teflan kin
Tier-0: Tiawi nen imai taos apu Kaluat kin, Apu apap Malao mana. Gar natkon gar malen kin ato chairman ni Land Trust ntau leven/
Tier-0: A gar preg natus ru waste money gar ser ntau ru pitlak money.
Tier-0: Ser ntau ru pitlak money, ntau inom, cheque gar imai, money gar ki, money gar ki.
Tier-0: Me mes ne, kin ru to, ru mer vote sa, runa ru vote, po mer vote wrong, me ru to Malachae Russell ki me Malachae Russell ina itkos,
Tier-0: Go money wan gar me ru tap wesi mau pan nruk mes ne.
Tier-0: Nlaken [ruto] Trust ki pe to wesi, ki pe lakor to use ki, imisuse kin ki.
Tier-0: Atlaken rui pe tu kai. Me ntan gar i to, go gar, Apu gar leg nen kin i tmalu wes, ga-, rui pi ntan gar.
Tier-0: Kinru mai, mai pak nanre ni na-, French missionary, gar me i po tefla, Apo tuer mani gar
Tier-0: A traus nam̃olien neu inom ato ler wes. A traus [na] agar pregi pan pan inom ru waste money wes.
Tier-0: Mes ne, ru vote, ru vote wrong, natam̃ol [rutae?] slati, i waste of money, ku ta tae esuan money ito pakes mau
Tier-0: Pak pan mai pak nigmam, nigmam mes kin ito, [rut] kineu a pato Erueti to iptlak natam̃ol nen ipi tepei. Ipi Susan Barnes,
Tier-0: nmatu, nen kin i puet Whitesheads Country Club. I mai tli kineu, itli na ka ga sign
Tier-0: anrikinkina "A kano, a kano gag {replace m̃tir nagiek} sign . Ina "Nlaken nafte?" go ana "Nlaken iku ", go ina "Nlaken kin, natam̃ol p̃otae [ni] ilekor, me ko preg ptaki vatu."
Tier-0: Me i [fo me] kerkerai ku tae, ku rispek ki nmatu, i mer mai lek wou nrak karu, imer mai nrak katol, go a trok.
Tier-0: ga preg natus, ga preg inom, ga sign wes, ga nagier ki pak es, [] na malfanen pa fo pan lek Malachae, kin ga isign.
Tier-0: Malen Malachae i sign, me i psakro ki wou, me i waste wan million neu. Islati mai pami. A tap tae wi mau, pan tuk mes.
Tier-0: Nrak kaaru, naftemena, nafte me, squash pumpkin ni Eum/.
Tier-0: Na mani nen i me [mai] slati i slati etan namer mra neu, i mer slati, i mer pan pregi mer puel pa, 1 million, 1.600.000 i think. I mer pan [].
Tier-0: Anrikinkir na "Malfane, a nom mus ka fo tao mus, me ka toreki neu court neu to go court nen kin a ta tkos to, {cough}
Tier-0: a toreki 1988 kin ru tkos to ki pe pi ntau ten ki, me court nen i ta to maag mau. Ita p̃on to.
Tier-0: Pan tuk mes. Mes nen a mer nen kin ru kens ki wou, ku tae, a lock, e?
Tier-0: A appeal Court, a lock kir, ru tiki san ruk ures (no road for them to go), go court nen i to, go nam̃er tar nen kin ru to ntan to, money kin i to sak.
Tier-0: Itfag mani ni [krak] ni government, ga ini panpan kin, i liuliu teflan tu, me kineu a lock
Tier-0: Ato pan pan kafotli ki, ru mai lek kineu san aliat fatoumlap nen pa, wik nen pa/
Tier-0: Ru mai lek kineu, a to san to, ru mai lek wou, a nrikirki na, "Ifwel kin uftaos namroan neu, (108) Go kafo weslu .. appeal nen a pregi to. Ka fo withdraw ki.
Tier-0: Me u tap mai,...u pato po kop namroan gamus pan pan utae na meltig ni Krismes, go utae na mani itik
Tier-0: I pi nlaken ru mai lek wou ko? Nafte kin u pitlaken umai na u mai nlaken ag kin ku wes ki.
